name: Berkay Yazar
title: Business Analyst · Scrum Master
about: Business Analyst with experience in insurance IT, working between stakeholders, developers and QA teams to keep delivery smooth. Background in Industrial Engineering and Business Administration, Scrum Master certified. I also work in independent theatre, which shapes how I think about coordination, limited resources and collective delivery.

items.title: Business Analyst & Scrum Master — Innovance Consultancy / Allianz Turkey (outsourced)
items.text: Member of the Business Development & Transformation team. Coordinating between stakeholders, developers and QA teams to ensure smooth delivery; leading Scrum ceremonies and ensuring effective application of Agile principles.

items.title: Business Analyst (Specialist) — Anadolu Insurance Company
items.text: Worked on the IT side of motor insurance products (mainly TPL and Casco) as business analyst and implementation engineer: analysing and implementing new requirements, resolving production defects, and coordinating with customers, developers and testers. Tools: Jira, Confluence, Sourcetree, SQL (Oracle), IDIT, MS Excel.

items.title: Candidate Engineer — FNSS Defence Systems Inc.
items.text: Quality Assurance and Business Excellence Department. Researched risk management and process management; took part in the development and testing of several systems under development.

items.title: Internships — FNSS Defence Systems Inc.; Nurol Makina Inc.
Multi-Team, Time-Window Team Routing — Graduation Project, Güven Hospital
items.text: Carried out in Güven Hospital's Home Healthcare Unit with a project group under academic consultancy. Developed a specialised MIP model under specific constraints and a decision support system in Python with solver and GIS libraries and open-source APIs.

items.title: B.Sc. Industrial Engineering — Başkent University
items.text: GPA 3.01/4. Theatre Society (Vice President, actor, assistant director); 104.2 RadyoBaşkent (anchor, producer); Sci-Fi, Fantasy & RPG Society (President).

items.title: Skills
items.text: Jira, Confluence, SQL, Python, MS Office; team management, communication, presentation.
